scope: Static source audit; no BREAK_URP edits and no experimental runtime changes

claims.claim: Shininess S maps to smoothness clamp01(1 - pow(2/(S+2), 0.125)); importer writes _Smoothness.
Map type 1 is 1-sqrt(value), type 2 is 1-value; scalar mode then multiplies or exponentiates. Supported 2D texture is stored in _SmoothnessTex.
claims.limitation: Unknown Ray sources/types are warning/manual domains; RTGI secondary samples LOD 0.

claims.claim: Ray metallic constant or supported map is imported to _Metallic / _MetallicGlossMap; RTGI hit samples map R and uses metallic for diffuse/specular split.
HoRTGI adapter supports lilToon opaque queue<AlphaTest and bounded cutout; unsupported opaque remains an occluder with no radiance payload.
Cutout any-hit evaluates MainTex/Color alpha plus AlphaMask and calls IgnoreHit below cutoff; surviving hit is shaded by the RTGI adapter.
claims.limitation: Only static Hidden/lilToonCutout alpha domain; dither, animation, main2/main3, parallax and property blocks are rejected.

claims.claim: Continuous transparent materials and Weighted OIT have no HoRT/RTGI any-hit/material hit path. OIT is raster accumulation/revealage/composite only.

excludedRayMaterials removes exact material submeshes from the HoRT AS; direct sky GI is opt-in via includeDirectEnvironment and requires atmosphere. Default useEnvironment is true but includeDirectEnvironment is false.
NRD RELAX is a denoiser stage after RTGI tracing/history; it does not change AS material classification or add alpha support.
lilToon raster variants compile reflection probe blending/box projection/atlas and call URP GlossyEnvironmentReflection; RTGI secondary adapter does not call probe APIs.
claims.limitation: Source proof only; no scene GPU capture of a populated probe atlas.

claims.claim: lilToon raster uses SampleAPV for L1/L2 SH when HoURP enables ProbeVolume keywords; RTGI secondary material has no SampleAPV path.
claims.limitation: APV is established for raster primary lighting only; no RTGI bounce claim.

claims.claim: Local volume pass supports Point/Spot sources with SD camera-depth/range or HD independent shadow atlas; it is a raster media pass.

limitations: No Unity GPU capture was run; claims are source-level and do not prove a specific scene's APV bake, probe atlas population, or active renderer ordering.
Continuous alpha, OIT, MME submaterial effects, and unsupported Ray texture sources remain outside the proven RTGI material domain.
The audit intentionally does not modify BREAK_URP or add experimental code.
